postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
clock_boundary: Inner psql spawn through completion, TCP loopback PG protocol and container-local chunk consumption; Docker/Python process elapsed is separately recorded. Not identical to EXPLAIN executor or direct-client fetch clocks.
first_header: Offset until the complete 19-byte COPY header is received; not HTTP TTFB.
byte_boundary: COPY payload only; PostgreSQL message/TCP framing bytes are not counted.
oracle: Exact deterministic COPY bytes/header/trailer, successful psql exit, unique native QueryFinish result_rows=1000000. No per-row Python parsing.
